svg.title: Vole dark GPUI workbench proposal
svg.desc: Static design proposal. A VOLE program is paused before adding registers R1 and R2 into R3. Assembly, instructions, decoded nibbles, registers, complete main memory and trace are visible.
svg.text: ; Add 3A and 43, then store at BB.
Add their values in eight bits.
Dashed cell BB: later store destination
